definitions.gloss: no matter how much, however much
definitions.explanation: Expresses that regardless of the degree or amount, the result is the same.

examples.japanese: いくら{食|た}べても{太|ふと}らない。
examples.english: No matter how much I eat, I don't gain weight.

examples.japanese: いくら{待|ま}っても{来|こ}なかった。
examples.english: No matter how long I waited, they didn't come.

examples.japanese: いくら{説明|せつめい}しても{分|わ}かってもらえない。
examples.english: No matter how much I explain, I can't get them to understand.

examples.japanese: いくら{頑張|がんば}っても{成績|せいせき}が{上|あ}がらなくて{悲|かな}しい。
examples.english: No matter how hard I try, my grades don't improve and it makes me sad.

examples.japanese: あの{映画|えいが}はいくら{見|み}ても{飽|あ}きないので、もう{十回|じゅっかい}{以上|いじょう}{見|み}ている。
examples.english: I never get tired of that movie no matter how many times I watch it, so I've seen it more than ten times.

notes:
いくら～ても expresses "no matter how much" - indicating that the result remains the same regardless of the degree or effort.

PATTERN:
いくら + verb (て form) + も

EXAMPLES:
- いくら{説明|せつめい}しても: no matter how much I explain
- いくら{食|た}べても: no matter how much I eat
- いくら{待|ま}っても: no matter how long I wait
- いくら{頑張|がんば}っても: no matter how hard I try

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- どんなに～ても: no matter how (emphasis on manner/degree)
- {何度|なんど}～ても: no matter how many times
- たとえ～ても: even if ~

NOTE:
Often implies frustration or resignation about unchanging results.
